description: Location: Inside the Slator Towing Inc company lot, with the area being used as an illegal Chop Shop. title: Hoop 1 – Mariana County
description: Location: In the northwest parking lot of the Jackal’s Track and Football Field. The hoop is next to the grass near the track, hanging from a dedicated post. The basketball is at the end of the track next to two folding chairs and a backpack.

title: Hoop 2 – Lummox County
description: Location: In the yard of a green house on Chestnut Dr near I-297. The hoop is in the corner of the driveway across from the garage. The basketball is on the ground underneath the hoop.

title: Hoop 3 – Vice-Dale County
description: Location: Inside the courtyard of a U-Shaped apartment complex. The hoop is in the direct center near a picnic table. The basketball is on the ground near the entrance and a staircase in front of a wooden chair.

title: Hoop 4 – Kelly County
description: Location: In front of a two-story green duplex on Magnolia Rd. The hoops is in the corner of a parking spot out front. The basketball is on the corner of the grass between the two walkways into the duplex.

title: Hoop 5 – Mariana County
description: Location: In front of a yellow house on Clovis Way in Capri. The hoop is on the side of the driveway next to an Invetero Coquette D10. The basketball is on the side of the house on top of a grate under a gutter spout.

title: Hoop 6 – Mariana County
description: Location: In the back courtyard of The Red Lotus store on the south side of Key Lento. The hoop is in the corner next to the opening of the fence into the back. The basketball is on the bricks nearby between a green container and a forklift.

title: Hoop 7 – Kelly County
description: Location: In front of an avid Henshaw supporter’s house on Reservoir St in the eastern outskirts of Ambrosia. The hoop is in front of the garage door of the house. The basketball is in the backyard against the fence next to the gate.

title: Hoop 8 – Vice-Dale County
description: Location: In front of a large villa on the west side of Catalan Island. The hoop is located in the corner of the driveway over an Obey 8F Drafter. The basketball is located in the corner of the hedges on the right side of the driveway, next to a Declasse ’20 Impaler.

title: Hoop 9 – Mariana County
description: Location: In front of a large villa in the northwestern peninsula of Capri. The hoop is in the corner of the driveway in front of the garage away from the house. The basketball is in the corner of the sidewalk on the side of the house against the wall.

title: Hoop 10 – Vice-Dale County
description: Location: Outside a small blue house on the corner of NW 24th Pl in southwestern Balsero. The hoop is in the corner of the driveway right next to the road. The basketball is located underneath the overhang garage against the wall between a trash bin and some gas tanks.

title: Hoop 11 – Mariana County
description: Location: On a basketball court near the beach in eastern Key Lento. The hoop is at the end of the court. The basketball is located on top of the court on the southeastern edge.

title: Hoop 12 – Leonard County
description: Location: At the end of the Cul-de-Sac on Fairview Dr in Waning Sands. The hoop is located between two brick driveways next to a potted plant. The basketball is located in the grass behind the hoop between the two houses.

title: Hoop 13 – Mariana County
description: Location: At a beach house on Coconut Cove Ct on the western side of Capri on the water. The hoop is located on the edge of the driveway next to the garage. The basketball is between the hoop and the garage next to an arrangement of potted plants.

title: Hoop 14 – Vice-Dale County
description: Location: In a small park area at the end of a side room coming off of Shorebeach Rd in eastern Washington Beach. The hoop is at the end of the sidewalk across from the restrooms. The basketball is located under a tree to the left of the hoop as the walkway narrows between the shrubs.

title: Hoop 15 – Vice-Dale County
description: Location: In front of a mansion on Delamore Dr across the street from the Leaf Links. The hoop is on the side of the driveway next to a hedge wall. The basketball is located on the ground in front of the post going into the front entrance.

title: Hoop 16 – Vice-Dale County
description: Location: At the Vice-Dale County Fire Rescue Station No. 35 building in central Port Vice City. The hoop is located on the side of the building between the two large garage doors. The basketball is on the grass next to the left door between an electrical box and two chairs under a DO NOT PARK HERE sign.

title: Hoop 17 – Vice-Dale County
description: Location: Between Northbrook Dr and NW 4th Ave under the I-404 bridge behind the PeeWees. The hoop is located at the southern end of the eastern court nearby. The basketball on the side of the west court next to a bench.

title: Hoop 18 – Vice-Dale County
description: Location: In the yard of a large villa on the northeastern side of Vespucci Island. The hoop is on the north side of the house against the garage. The basketball is located in the corner of the small retaining wall connecting to the pond in front of the hoop

title: Hoop 19 – Vice-Dale County
description: Location: At a small blue house at the corner of SW 17th St and SW 7th Ave in western Vice City, just outside VCIA. The hoop is located at the end of the driveway in front of the house. The basketball is in the left corner of the porch next to two potted plants.

title: Hoop 20 – Vice-Dale County
description: Location: Between Northbrook Dr and NW 4th Ave under the I-404 bridge behind the PeeWees. The hoop is located at the northern end of the eastern court nearby. The basketball on the side of the west court next to a bench.

title: Hoop 21 – Leonard County
description: Location: In a courtyard on the eastern side of the large outdoor mall on the south side of Waning Sands. The hoop is in front of the Baller World store on the right side of the entrance. The basketball is located right under the hoop next to the right door.

title: Hoop 22 – Kelly County
description: Location: At a small house on the river in northeastern Ambrosia on Reservoir St. The hoop is located above the garage door next to a flag. The basketball is located inside the garage on the floor between a bike and a Bravado Copperheads Gauntlet.

title: Hoop 23 – Vice-Dale County
description: Location: On the south side of the Gloriana Key on Gloriana Key Rd outside the Vice Rowing Club building. The hoop is on the left side of the building between the staircase and the garage doors. The basketball is under a tree across from the hoop near a trash receptacle area.

title: Hoop 24 – Lummox County
description: Location: In the open courtyard in front of the Overkeel Boatyard & Marina in eastern East Lummox County. The hoop is located in the front loading area of the secondary building next to a garage door behind a delivery truck. The basketball is under the left picnic table on the side of the same building.

title: Hoop 25 – Vice-Dale County
description: Location: In the yard of a large villa in the center of Vespucci Island, off Neptune Cir. The hoop is hanging from the side of the house above the garage door at the end of the driveway. The basketball is located on the side of the house, next to the hoop, on the small brick path against the hose.

title: Hoop 26 – Vice-Dale County
description: Location: At the large mansion in the northwest corner of Peacock Estates on Tubbs Pl. The hoop is hanging from an independent support at the far right end of the driveway. The basketball is located against the wall under a lamp just next to the hoop.

title: Hoop 27 – Vice-Dale County
description: Location: At the southern-most mansion in Peacock Estates at the end of Palladia Ln. The hoop is hanging on an independent post between the two garage doors on the side of the mansion. The basketball is located against the wall near the patio with the workout equipment under a window.

title: Hoop 28 – Vice-Dale County
description: Location: At a green house off Northbrook Dr on the river in the southwestern part of Little Cuba. The hoop is hanging from an independent post between two windows in the backyard. The basketball is underneath the crane in the backyard that’s hanging over the river.

title: Hoop 29 – Vice-Dale County
description: Location: In the parking lot of an apartment building next to the SR-25 bridge going over the river in the middle of Little Cuba. The hoop is hanging from an independent post on a small patch of grass in the outside corner of the apartment building. The basketball is on the southeastern sidewalk of the building in front of an apartment door.

title: Hoop 30 – Leonard County
description: Location: In the driveway of the white house in the Waning Sands in the middle of Fairview Dr on the east side. The hoop is in the middle of the brick driveway near the house. The basketball is directly under the hoop between the hoop and the door.

title: Hoop 31 – Kelly Count
description: Location: On the northwestern side of an outdoor entertainment center in northern Ambrosia. The hoop is hanging from a pole at the northeastern end of the basketball court next to the ten

title: Hoop 32 – Vice-Dale County
description: Location: In the back of the abandoned Kamar Devon Community Center in the northern part of the Southside of Vice City. The hoop is against the barbed wire stone fence in the back courtyard. The basketball is at the base of the barbed wire stone fence at the right side of the court on the three-point line.

title: Hoop 33 – Mariana County
description: Location: Against the side of the large blue house with a boat on a trailer in the driveway on the northside of Watson Bay. The hoop is hanging on the side of the house above the garage door. The basketball is under the porch against the wall between the house and the Karin Allander.

title: Hoop 34 – Vice-Dale County
description: Location: In the courtyard between the Eris store and the Sahara Arena in Downtown Vice City on the water. The hoop is hanging in the middle of a white ring in the middle of the courtyard, surrounded by red lights. The basketball is on a rack next to the entrance of the hoop area.

title: Hoop 35 – Mariana County
description: Location: In Key Lento at the green-colored house on the corner of Peach Palm Dr across the street from Gambit Bay. The hoop is hanging above the detached garage. The basketball is located on the gravel path to the right side of the garage.

title: Hoop 36 – Vice-Dale County
description: Location: On the corner of Westbrook Dr at the yellow and stone house in the middle of Salton in Vice City, next to VCIA. The hoop is located at the end of the driveway next to the house. The basketball is in the backyard on the ground next to a line of bushes.

title: Hoop 37 – Mariana County
description: Location: In the middle of Watson Bay on Seabell Ave at the long, beige house across the street from the STD Contractor construction entrance. The hoop is above the detached garage door. The basketball is on the oddly-colored patch of concrete in the driveway.

title: Hoop 38 – Leonard County
description: Location: On the north side of Belville in a park with a small lake. The basketball hoop is hanging on the northern pole on the west side of the two basketball courts. The basketball is located in front of one of the bleachers next to the court.

title: Hoop 39 – Lummox County
description: Location: At the Stone Hill Sawnmill in the northern part of the Mount Kalaga National Park. The hoop is hanging from the side of the sawmill building. The basketball is located in front of the door at the top of the stairs heading in.

title: Hoop 40 – Mariana County

description: _Randy will buy certain high-end vehicles at his showroom, and offers repairs and resprays._

title: Moses
description: _Moses will buy low-key untracked vehicles at his auto shop, and offers repairs and resprays. He'll also register them as personal vehicles, for a fee._

title: Yasmani
description: _Yasmani will buy stolen goods at his shop. For an extra cut, he'll arrange a pick-up from your garage._ Drop-off Prices: - Narcotics: Medium - Jewelry: Highest - Marked Bills: Highest

title: Kenton

title: Brian's Lockup

title: Pete

title: Office Safe - Sunrise RV Park
description: Location: Behind the counter of the main building in Sunrise RV Park. A Key Valuable of the Kingfisher Illegal Operation at the Sunrise RV Park.

title: Dock Warehouse Safe - Sunset RV Park
description: Location: Inside a building by the dock on the southside of the Sunrise RV Park. A Key Valuable of the Kingfisher Illegal Operation at the Sunrise RV Park.

title: Garage Safe - Nova Auto Junkyard
description: Location: Inside the main building of the Nova Auto Junkyard in Hamlet. A Key Valuable of the M7 Illegal Operation at the Nova Auto Junkyard.

title: Safe - Manatee Motel
description: Location: Inside a motel room at the Manatee Motel in Grassrivers. You'll likely witness a mauling. A Key Valuable of the Kingfisher Illegal Operation at the Manatee Motel.

title: Safe - Watson Bay Safe House
description: Location: In the second floor kitchen of the Watson Bay Safe House in Watson Bay. A Key Valuable of the La Polilla Negra Illegal Operation at the Watson Bay Safe House.

title: Safe - Palmer Fishing Warehouse
description: Location: In the corner of the second floor office in the Palmer Fisheries building at the south end of Bobcat Key. A Key Valuable of the La Polilla Negra Illegal Operation at the Palmer Fishing Warehouse.

title: Locked Safe - Mill Station Radar Base
description: Location: Next to the desk in a makeshift storage room at the Mill Station Radar Base. Enter the building through the underpass and make a left to find it through a few doors, or drop down from the roof, go straight through the double doors, then make a right. This is a Key Valuable at the Mill Station Radar Base.

title: Safe - Exotic Animal Front
description: Location: - In the storage room in the back of Three Sheets Liquor, which is actually an Exotic Animal Front, off of Sunbelt Highway on Key Lento. The Key Valuable of the [Exotic Animal Front Illegal Operation](https://mapgenie.io/grand-theft-auto-6/maps/leonida?locationIds=1091987).

title: Safe - Illegal Goods Store
description: Location: In the back office of the Illegal Goods Store (Krystal Inc. Electronics) off of SW 13th St in the north part of Southside. The door to the office on the southeast side of the building is locked from the outside, but you can climb the shipping containers there to get to the roof. Drop down the southern opening right on top of the office. This safe is a Key Valuable of the PTTYoungin$ Illegal Operation at the Illegal Goods Store.

title: Safe - Slator Towing Inc
description: Location: In the office at Slator Towing Inc, between SW 7th and SW 8th Ave in Salton. Enter by hopping the short wall to the left of the entrance on Sw 8th Ave. This safe is a Key Valuable of the Illegal Operation at Slator Towing Inc.

title: Safe - Industrial Weed Grow
description: Location: In the elevated office at the very north west end of the Industrial Weed Grow warehouse in North Mariana County. This safe is a Key Valuable of the Illegal Operation at the Industrial Weed Grow.

title: Office Safe - Saber Shipping Facility
description: Location: Inside the back office on the west side of the north building in Saber Shipping Yard off of Northbrook Drive in Little Cuba. You can climb straight into the office from the open window in the back. This office safe is a Key Valuable of the Guardia Brothers Illegal Operation at the Saber Shipping Yard.

title: Safe - Casa Guardia
description: Location: Inside Casa Guardia on the second floor balcony, in the southwestern corner. The abandoned building is off of NW 3rd Ave in Little Cuba. Climb the ladder on the west side of the building and drop down from the roof access for easy access to the safe. This safe is a Key Valuable of the Guardia Brothers Illegal Operation at Casa Guardia.

title: Safe - Saber Shipping Facility
description: Location: In the upstairs office of the Saber Shipping Facility off of Westbrook Drive in Balsero. The door at the top of the roof will lead you right to this area. This safe is a Key Valuable of the Guardia Brothers Illegal Operation at the Saber Shipping Facility.

title: Safe - Parlor Apartments
description: Location: In the back living area on the first floor inside the Parlor Apartments building off of Northbrook Drive in Rockridge. You can enter the apartment from the apartment building's front entrance, or through an open garage on the west side of the of the building from Northbrook Drive. From the garage, jump up through the opening in the wall, make a left, and the apartment entrance will be on your left. This safe is a Key Valuable of the San4San Illegal Operation at the Parlor Apartments.

title: Office Safe - Chatfield Storage & Logistics
description: Location: On the second floor of the site office at Chatfield Storage & Logistics on Waxman Island. This safe is a Key Valuable of the Illegal Operation at the Chatfield Storage & Logistics.

title: Safe - Ocean Beach Lab
description: Location: In an office in the back of the Gabriel Wexler salon building (Ocean Beach Lab) off of Atlantic Ave in Ocean Beach. Break into the main lab room from the alley on the west side of the building to find the office on the right. This safe a Key Valuable of the Illegal Operation at Ocean Beach Lab.

title: Armory Safe - Vespucci Mansion
description: Location: In a room on the second floor of Vespucci Mansion, overlooking the pool and canal through west-facing sliding glass doors. The room can be accessed from these sliding glass doors or the interior door. Find Vespucci Mansion off of Neptune Circle on Vespucci Island, part of the Rialto Islands. The Armory Safe is a Key Valuable of the Illegal Operation at the Vespucci Mansion.

title: Armory Safe 2 - Vespucci Mansion
description: Location: In a room on the second floor of Vespucci Mansion, overlooking the pool and canal through west-facing sliding glass doors. The room can be accessed from these sliding glass doors or the interior door. Find Vespucci Mansion off of Neptune Circle on Vespucci Island, part of the Rialto Islands. The Armory Safe 2 is a Key Valuable of the Illegal Operation at the Vespucci Mansion.

title: Safe - Leonida Carrier Warehouse
description: Location: In the corner of the backroom behind the office inside the Leonida Carrier Warehouse. Make your way to this room from the the west garage entrance, or climb the outside ladder on the southeastern side of the building to gain roof access. This safe is a Key Valuable of the Illegal Operation at the Leonida Carrier Warehouse.

title: Safe - Cigar Import Front
description: Location: In the back room of the Palmis Liquor (Cigar Import Front) off Del Rio Blvd in La Perle. Break open the "Staff Only" door behind the counter. This safe is a Key Valuable of the Illegal Opertion at the Cigar Import Front.

title: Safe -Janjak's Garage
description: Location: In an office area through the north garage entrance inside Janjak's Garage, just north of Del Rio Blvd in La Perle. To be a little more stealthy, enter by climbing the ladder outside on the west side of the building and dropping down right on top of the office. This safe is a Key Valuable of the San4San Illegal Operation at Janjak's Garage.

title: Safe - Illegal Sneaker Trade
description: Location: In the back, staff-only room of Drip Drops on Del Rio Blvd in La Perle. You can break in from the front or enter through the backdoor from the alley on the east side. This safe is is a Key Valuable of the San4San Illegal Operation at the Illegal Sneaker Trade.

title: Safe - Sound4Sound Studio
description: Location: Inside the recording booth control room at the Sound4Sound Studio in Stockyard, north of Vice City. Try entering from the doors on the east side of the building for easier access, but you can also get there through the storage room with the Unique Weapon Variant in it that's to the right of the "Employee Only" entrance. This safe is a Key Valuable of the San4San Illegal Operation at the Sound4Sound Studio.

title: Safe
description: Location: In the back room through the "Staff Only" door of the 247 Gas (Gas Station Meth Front) in Emerald Springs off of CR 62. This safe is the Key Valuable of the Illegal Operation at the Gas Station Meth Front.

title: Safe - Irons Building Supply
description: Location: In the upstairs office past the balcony gym setup in the Irons Building Supply in Ambrosia. This safe is a Key Valuable of the Final Chapter Illegal Operation at the Irons Building Supply.

title: Office Safe - Hog Stars Garage
description: Location: In the back office of the Hog Stars Garage, on Acacia St. in Ambrosia of Kelly County. You can enter from an open skylight on the roof by climbing a ladder on the southwestern side of the building. Beware of dogs, though. Once inside, go left through the opening beneatht the Live and Ride Another Day banner to find the office entrance on the left. This office safe is a Key Valuable of the Final Chapter Illegal Operation at the Hog Stars Garage.

title: Safe - Biker Hideout
description: Location: In the restricted back room in the northwest part of The Thirsty Wolf, a Biker Hideout, on SR-27 in the north part of Belville. You can break directly into this room from out back--the safe is on the right from this door. This safe is a Key Valuable of the Final Chapter Illegal Operation at the Biker Hideout.

title: Safe - Farm Fix Meth Lab
description: Location: In the back corner of the second floor office in the southeastern part of the the Farm Fix Meth Lab off of Chastity Ave in the rural, northern part of Belville. You can try climbing up the AC unit on the north side of the building, then dropping down the southeastern most skylight on top of the office. This safe is a Key Valuable of the Final Chapter Illegal Operation at the Farm Fix Meth Lab.

title: Office Safe - Kingpin Bowling
description: Location: In a back office, found through a "Storage" door, in the northeastern part of the abandoned Kingpin Bowling alley, off US-9 in Port Gellhorn. You can also find the safe by climbing a ladder on the east side of the building, then dropping down an open latch with a ladder. This drops you right next to the office. This safe is a Key Valuable of the Kolt & Associates Illegal Operation at Kingpin Bowling.

title: Locked Safe - Backroom Weed Front
description: Location: In the back room of the Pearl House Hair Salon in the southern part of Port Gelhorn. Break into the back room from the west side of the building. This safe is the Key Valuable of the Illegal Operation at the Backroom Weed Front.

title: Safe - June Warehouse
description: **Location:* Beside the fridge in the south part of June Warehouse off of US-9 and Glenwood Ave in Port Gellhorn. Enter from the side door on the south side of the building to find it immediately to your left. This safe is a Key Valuable of the Kolt & Associates Illegal Operation at June Warehouse.

title: Lieutenant Room Safe - La Cascara Motel
description: Location: Inside a protected room, from the northwest door outside, on the top floor on the northwest side of the abandoned La Cascara Motel, on the beach in Port Gellhorn. Climb the staircase at the northern part of the building, and make sure to bring sticky bombs to open the way. The Lieutenant Room Safe is a Key Valuable of the Kolt & Associates Illegal Operation at La Cascara Motel.

title: Office Safe - Brooks Boatworks
description: Location: Inside an office on the second story of the fishery building at the north end of Port Gellhorn. This room is accessible from outside, not inside the fishery itself. You can sneak straight into this room through an open window by going up the outdoor stairs on the northeast side of the building, then jumping up onto the roof. This Office Safe is a Key Valuable of the Kolt & Associates Illegal Operation at Brooks Boatworks.

title: Warehouse Safe - Brooks Boatworks
description: Location: In an office upstairs inside the main Brooks Boatworks warehouse, located in the northern part of Port Gellhorn off of Gellhorn Ave. Find the particular stairs that lead to the office by entering from the shudder doors on the southeastern side of the building and looking to the left.

title: Safe - Stash House
description: Location: Just past the kitchen inside the stash house on Gellhorn Ave in Port Gellhorn. While facing the front of the house from Gellhorn Ave, enter through the side door on the right (south side) of the house straight into the kitchen. The safe is on your right just past the doorway by the fridge. This safe is a Key Valuable of the Kolt & Associates Illegal Operation at the Stash House.

title: Locked Safe - Walker Farm
description: Location: By the computers just inside the main north entrance beneath the awning of the main Walker Farm building. Find the rural farm off of SR-32 in Frogswater, between Ambrosia and Port Gellhorn. There's an opening in the perimeter fence on the east side. Use the trailers by the fence there to jump up and over a gap in the fence missing the barbed wire. The Locked Safe is a Key Valuable of the Illegal Operation at Walker Farm.

title: Safe - Weed Grow
description: Location: In an office just inside the southwestern entrance of the largest warehouse at M7's Weed Grow in Tallaloko. This safe is a Key Valuable of the M7 Illegal Operation at the Weed Grow.

title: RV Safe - Weed Grow
description: Location: In an RV on the northwest side of the compound at M7's Weed Grow in Tallaloko. This RV safe is a Key Valuable of the M7 Illegal Operation at the Weed Grow.

title: Locked Safe - Carter Mining Boathouse
description: Location: Just inside to the left of the main southeastern entrance to the Carter Mining Boathouse. This locked safe is the Key Valuable of the Illegal Operation at the Carter Mining Boathouse.
